mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real GDP signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in declining GDP periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 1% within the last two months signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in retail sales signals a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases & RSAFS decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in the last month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in both housing starts and nonfarm payrolls by more than 1% and 100,000 respectively within the last month signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 1% & PAYEMS increase > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
